business_problem: TMBThanachart Bank needed a better way to support hyperpersonalized banking offers, digital sales, and fraud-aware decisioning because the bank's legacy personalization stack could not scale customer data, speed up insights, or support millions of real-time engagement decisions.
solution_summary: TMBThanachart Bank uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support hyperpersonalized banking offers, digital sales, and fraud-aware decisioning. The implementation replaced a legacy state where the bank's legacy personalization stack could not scale customer data, speed up insights, or support millions of real-time engagement decisions. Customer profiles and transaction streams move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Curated datasets and applications deliver hyperpersonalized offers and digital sales insights to downstream users.
